column3: conv.configure checks the disabled set inside the commit that writes the model (pi's configure(tx)), its only check, instead of a pre-check plus a post-commit revert
column4: Bosun asked for a race test that holds a configure between its check and its commit; pi runs reads and commits on one FIFO line, so an op cannot be paused there from a test, while a check inside the commit is atomic with the write: a models.enable either lands first and is seen, or finds the conversation on the model and moves it
column5: models.test.ts: concurrent configure and disable never leave the conversation on the disabled model; removing the in-commit check fails the disabled-model refusal tests (mutation run)
